468:t_024:1.en:
$$凱$$
「Is that female android sending energy to $$マジンガー$$!?」

468:t_024:2.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「My $$Ｑちゃん$$ had a function built into her by Dr. $$剣造$$ to control Photon Power energy, you see!」

468:t_024:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Futile! Adding a little of the power of light now changes nothing! It cannot defeat my darkness!」

468:t_024:5.en:
$n
「Wake up, $$甲児$$! Where there is hope, light is born!!」

468:t_025:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Ngh... $$マジンガー$$...! Together... with me...」

468:t_026:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't worry about me, $n! More importantly, you protect that cutie no matter what!」

468:t_026:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Why, $$竜馬$$!? Why do you go this far to protect $$甲児$$!?」

468:t_026:4.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$ sees himself in $$甲児$$.」

468:t_026:5.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$甲児$$ looks a lot like this guy back when he was a kid. Well, this guy's gotten a little older and twisted since then.」

468:t_026:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... I let you see something pretty embarrassing.」

468:t_026:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Hey, $$甲児$$! After making me go this far for you, you're still half asleep!?」

468:t_026:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If you don't wake up right now, it's back to square one on your training!!」

468:t_027:1.en:
$$剣造$$
「$$甲児$$ has now... become one with Photon Power energy...」

468:t_028:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Look, Big Sis! Even the terrain has changed!」

468:t_028:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Look, Big Sis! Even the terrain has changed!」

468:t_028:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Look, Big Sis! Even the terrain has changed!」

468:t_028:4.en:
$$さやか$$
「This is...! It's the $$科学要塞研究所$$ from before $$ミケーネ$$ came!」

468:t_028:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is this the power of Photon Power energy...!」

468:t_028:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Power is welling up from the depths of my body...!」

468:t_029:0.en:
$$剣造$$
「Photon Power... it is the force that seeks to exist...」

468:t_029:1.en:
$$剣造$$
「That force can even create something from nothing.」

468:t_029:2.en:
$$號$$
「That is precisely the power of light.」

468:t_029:3.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Impossible...! How can this be! Lord $$ハーデス$$, please answer me! Lord $$ハーデス$$!!」

468:t_029:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Calling out is useless, $$ガラダブラ$$! $$ハーデス$$ vanished before my light!」

468:t_029:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Curse you, Demon God of Light!! Then I will avenge Lord $$ハーデス$$!」

468:t_029:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「If Photon Power can create something from nothing...!」

468:t_029:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「That power Professor $$弓$$ and the others prepared for me and $$マジンガー$$... I'll revive it right here, right now!!」

468:t_029:9.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「What are you planning to do!?」

468:t_030:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「Did $$マジンガー$$ create that Rocket Punch!?」

468:t_030:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Now that's a true Super Robot!」

468:t_031:0.en:
$$オジイちゃん$$
「You did it, $$甲児$$.」

468:t_031:2.en:
$$オジイちゃん$$
「Now that you've awakened to the true light, I have nothing more to say to you.」

468:t_031:3.en:
$$オジイちゃん$$
「I shall go to sleep. From here on, you must guide $$マジンガー$$.」

468:t_031:4.en:
$$オジイちゃん$$
「Whether you make it a god or a devil... it all depends on you.」

468:t_031:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Even I'm worn out. From here on, I'll be backing you up.」

468:t_032:1.en:
$$クロス$$
「Quit dawdling and link up with $n.」

468:t_032:5.en:
$$お菊$$
「Come now, boys. We'll give you a hand.」

468:t_032:6.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Now that we're here, you've got nothing to be afraid of.」

468:t_032:8.en:
$$ボス$$
「R-right! If that's how it is, I'll do it!!」

468:t_033:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「Let's do this, $n! Now that $$甲児$$ has shown what a man he is, I've got no choice but to follow!」

468:t_035:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「As expected, folks who came back from hell have different guts.」

468:t_035:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We go on the offensive with $$マジンガー$$ at the center. Our target is $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$.」

468:t_035:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ガラダブラ$$! This time I'm settling this for good!」

468:t_035:4.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I will not retreat! For Lord $$ハーデス$$'s sake as well!!」

468:t_035:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「The light that dispelled that very $$ハーデス$$! I'll show it to you, too!!」

468:t_036:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「You don't know when to give up!」

468:t_036:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Then let's finish you off!」

468:t_036:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「The power of darkness is gathering... Soon my body will be resurrected as well.」

Ｑちゃん.evidence: Ankokuji's pet name for Gamia Q (ガミアＱ, glossary) in Mazinger lore; Kei/Gai refer to her as the female android who feeds energy to Mazinger in the same scene

kept_omissions: 468:t_026:5: 'this guy' kept for こいつ; 'who is older' subject is Ryouma.
468:t_029:6/468:t_036:2: targets are Garadoublas (gender unknown); pronoun 'em/we kept neutral.
uncertain: Ｑちゃん (Ankokuji's pet name for Gamia Q): not a sheet token, proposed as $$Ｑちゃん$$ = Q-chan; if the orchestrator prefers, swap to $$ガミアＱ$$ with -chan outside.
光の魔神 = 'Demon God of Light' (魔神 kept as Demon God; Zeus/Garadoublas name Mazinger this way in neighbouring slices); please align with 2065_01/02 renderings.
ハーデス様 (Garadoublas to Hades) = 'Lord $$ハーデス$$': kept a title rather than drop the deference; the style guide only settles Lady Elluna.
468:t_026:1 そのカワイコちゃん: referent unsettled (Sayaka vs Kouji teased); kept as 'that cutie'.
468:t_026:5 今は...ひねちまった: read as Ryouma (こいつ) who has aged and turned sour, not Kouji.
468:t_025:2 奴が息を吹き返す前に: 奴 taken as Kouji/Mazinger, rendered 'he'.
468:t_025:0 共に is a cut-off phrase; kept as 'Together... with me...'.
468:t_028:2/3 duplicate Nono lines under Buster Machine No. 7 / Diebuster speaker lines, translated identically.
光子力 = 'Photon Power'; 特訓 = 'training'; 科学要塞研究所 = 'Science Fortress Research Institute' (as in 2065_00).
